Assessment scope: renewed independent M2 Code Review of the complete b805a0b3..dcc357b4 engineering change. The narrow correction since first pass48077547 changes only workflow-context.js diagnostic collection and its public subprocess regression. Current approved Proposal, Record Format/CLI/Workflow Design and clarified Delivery package identities were mechanically inspected and matched again. The reviewer did not author or edit implementation, tests, models, plan or routing. M1 remains predecessor evidence; this exact M2 judgment does not renew M1 on changed subjects.

Correction assessment: the first-pass public reproduction is retained in the immutable finding origin. The collector now normalizes diagnostics first, then coalesces identical code/path pairs while preserving rejected status and incomplete scope. Fixed messages are functions of normalized code, so equal code/path also means equal diagnostic triple; distinct safe paths or codes remain distinct. Redacted names are not reintroduced and validation is not weakened. The real public regression failed before correction with exit1 instead of2, then passed through the actual binary. This addresses the cause before final result validation rather than masking an internal error downstream.

Independent direct proof after correction: created an isolated project with .git, BAD and OTHER immediate directories and one valid example v2 store. Invoked the actual binary workflow-context --json. Asserted exit2, schema2 rejected, scope.complete false, one redacted invalid-input diagnostic, the valid example retained as an explicitly incomplete partial candidate, and no BAD/OTHER disclosure. A recursive snapshot of every project directory and file before/after was equal. This extends the author's two-invalid-ID regression with partial-candidate composition and no-mutation proof. No project source or authoritative record was edited by that reproduction.

Requirement alignment — pass for M2/TG-02/TG-03. V2 is the only accepted stored recording format; request and result transports retain independent schema1 where contracted. The source/request validators, targeted construction/query/observations/spans, live/exact-snapshot validator and current selector callers consistently remove v1 storage branches. Retained v2 operation definitions, Origin capture/preservation and field-specific EntryRef behavior remain unchanged. M3 compact/lifecycle engines and M4 governing/public package guidance are still explicitly pending; no completed retirement or adoption is claimed.

Architecture and compatibility — pass. Neutral advanced envelopes retain closed shape and diagnostic checks; v2 snapshot membership/order/content/identity/revision remains representation-owned, including absent roots and missing sidecars. Shared storage-safety tests use synthetic v2 fixture bytes with explicit origins; fixture similarity is not a migration of product records. Stored-v1 codec/schema and exclusive operation definitions are removed while independent document/transport version domains remain. No new semantic readiness engine or archive service is introduced.

Recovery, security and failure boundaries — pass within this slice. Journal.version2 selects v2; saved before/candidate manifests, writes, read sets and identities remain validated before recovery effects. Initial creation needs no existing current manifest. Retired/unknown selectors, inconsistent saved basis, tampered origins and third-state bytes reject. Existing lock/exclusion, conflict/lost-response retry, atomic publication and no-overwrite boundaries remain in actual public/persistence/install tests. Discovery errors now compose into the exact safe response even when multiple bad IDs normalize identically. It performs no repair or recovery.

Discovery/configuration — pass. Presence classification prioritizes both manifests, present current JSON, missing-manifest reserved residue, then YAML archive/non-current exclusion without parsing archives. Explicit IDs use exact coherent snapshots and bypass unrelated enumeration; malformed or incomplete v2 cannot become a valid candidate. Inclusive1024-directory/64-candidate and8MiB response validation, safe enumeration, ordering and incomplete-scope reporting remain intact. Configuration retains separate schema1/YAML/non-record placement with current fixed record paths, owner validation and no review-resolution kind. No candidate automatically selects workflow authority.

Tests and maintenance — pass. Positive stored-v1 representation/front-matter/origin-unavailable/broad-reference tests are explicitly decontracted; legacy workflow-context eligibility assertions leave with the replaced projection. Shared representation limits, exact result/snapshot checks, transaction/recovery, v2 namespaces/references, public errors and correction-after-completion remain protected. The added regression protects a distinct redaction/aggregation/public-dispatch interaction. No protection is inferred from test counts. The8MiB boundary cases exercise synthetic public-envelope validation, not three actual8MiB CLI executions; current public dispatch and the new independent composition reproduction cover their stated outcomes.

Evidence — pass for assessed scope. Fresh m2-discovery-diagnostic-correction binds both corrected subjects and reports full workflow-context33pass and full npm490pass/0skip; the actual completed logs were inspected. Earlier M2 complete storage168, metadata116/query27/selector174/boundary87/cache14 and additional artifact-lifecycle171/governed-wrapper21/npm-package7 retain their explicit unaffected scope. The correction touches only discovery diagnostic collection and its test; storage, selectors and Python validation dependencies/procedures were not changed, so these existing passes remain usable under the governing reuse policy. A fresh broad rerun of those unchanged paths is not required by this correction. Existing failed historical audit/drift remains disclosed and is not a universal green baseline. Generator/model/record/whitespace evidence remains structural rather than semantic approval.

Generated output and scope — pass. Canonical/bundled targeted schemas and neutral transport generation match; no schema or package artifact is affected by the final diagnostic correction. No archival change/review/evidence bytes are converted, no unrelated refactor or new format is included. Existing exact deleted baseline paths and identities remain recorded below, distinguishing absent engineering from current subjects.

No required M2 correction remains after the explicit finding disposition in this batch. Return to route for milestone disposition; this reviewer has not closed work or advanced activity. M3 and M4 remain, then a fresh independent final whole-change Code Review and separate Verify. Branch/PR/CI/final retirement readiness is not claimed.

findings.evidence: Medium; M2/TG-03, CLI-SR-23; owning stage implement. workflow-context.js executeWorkflowContext inspect/fail accumulates the same invalid-input diagnostic with path:null for every unsafe change ID. validateWorkflowContextResult then invokes validateAdvancedEnvelope, whose duplicate-diagnostic check throws outside the error handler. Isolated actual binary reproduction with immediate docs/changes/BAD and docs/changes/OTHER yields exit1, empty stdout and RL_CLI_INTERNAL instead of schema2 rejected/exit2. Invalid names are correctly redacted, but repeated redaction produces an invalid emitted envelope.

origin.rationale: The approved factual discovery contract requires explicit safe diagnostics and exit2 for invalid enumeration/candidate input. An expected malformed-project condition currently escapes into an internal failure, so M2 cannot close despite green existing suites.
origin.required_outcome: Preserve safe redaction and fail-closed validation while ensuring all collected errors form a valid bounded schema2 rejection; identical diagnostics may be safely coalesced. Add a real public-command regression with multiple invalid directory IDs that asserts exit2, schema2 rejected, scope.complete false, no payload disclosure and unchanged project bytes. Preserve valid/partial candidate and single-error behavior. Safe correction path: M2 implementation owner fixes collection/serialization and reruns focused regression plus complete affected workflow-context module and required affected proof, then independent M2 rereview. No Design decision or legacy acceptance restoration is needed.

Complete discovery33 and npm490 pass on corrected subjects. Original supporting judgment, subjects and failure evidence are preserved in origin.
